P1para.Text: This Regulation establishes a ... system for control, inspection and enforcement ... to ensure compliance with Fisheries Rules.

P1group.Title: Completion and submission of the fishing logbook

P1para.Text: Without prejudice to specific provisions, the master of each United Kingdom fishing vessel shall keep a fishing logbook of operations (Article 14).

Title.Addition: Separate stowage of catches below the minimum conservation reference sizes

Text.Addition: All catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board a

fishing vessel shall be placed in boxes, compartments or containers in such a way that they are identifiable from other boxes, compartments or containers. Those catches shall not be mixed with any other fishery products.

Addition.Substitution: where the catches contain more than 80% of one or more of the following species—
mackerel, herring, horse mackerel, blue whiting, boarfish, anchovy, argentine, sardine, sprat (i.e. small pelagic fisheries);
capelin, sandeel, Norwegian pout (i.e. fisheries for industrial purposes);

Text.Addition: to fishing vessels of less than 12 metres' length overall where catches below the minimum conservation reference size have been sorted, estimated and recorded in accordance with Article 14 of this Regulation.
In the cases referred to in paragraph 2,
monitor the catch composition by way of sampling.

Para.Text: Substituted by Regulation (EU) 2015/812 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 May 2015 amending Council Regulations (EC) No 850/98, (EC) No 2187/2005, (EC) No 1967/2006, (EC) No 1098/2007, (EC) No 254/2002, (EC) No 2347/2002 and (EC) No 1224/2009, and Regulations (EU) No 1379/2013 and (EU) No 1380/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council, as regards the landing obligation, and repealing Council Regulation (EC) No 1434/98.

Inserted by Regulation (EU) 2015/812 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 May 2015 amending Council Regulations (EC) No 850/98, (EC) No 2187/2005, (EC) No 1967/2006, (EC) No 1098/2007, (EC) No 254/2002, (EC) No 2347/2002 and (EC) No 1224/2009, and Regulations (EU) No 1379/2013 and (EU) No 1380/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council, as regards the landing obligation, and repealing Council Regulation (EC) No 1434/98.
